definition: Waffles is a collection of command-line tools for performing machine learning operations developed at Brigham Young University.
details: These tools are written in C++, and are available under the GNU Lesser General Public License.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Waffles (machine learning).
